## Release Gates

- [ ] Command steps pass with `counts.fail = 0`
- [ ] Evidence gates pass with `counts.gatesBlocked = 0`
- [ ] `productionReady = true`
- [ ] `releaseAllowed = true`
- [ ] `shipDecision = SHIP`
- [ ] No fake rights, payment, signing, live-stream, reviewer, GUI, or production proof is introduced

**Status:** Release Gates CI will update the PR with the generated evidence status.
